audit.whatIsWrong: Flagged defect: Yorick wins 53.04% over 3,186 games but the chart gave Lucian 5 of 7 stages and Yorick none, with difficulty at 8.5/10 under a FAV label.
audit.why: The already-audited mirror settled Level 6 as Skill and both item rows as Yorick, at 6/10 difficulty with a 7/10 carry threat. That matches the shape of the lane: Lucian owns levels 1-3 with ranged poke, but once Maiden is permanent and Yorick has items the brawl and the side lane belong to him. The page's own whys[4] already called level 6 even.
audit.corrected: win[4]/phases[4].side to Skill (5/10), win[5]/phases[5].side to Yorick (6/10), win[6]/phases[6].side to Yorick (6/10); diffRating 8.5/10 to 6/10, carryRating 8.5/10 to 7/10, and the four prose lines quoting those numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4..6].why were boilerplate and, after the rows moved, said the opposite of their own rows; whys[5] and whys[6] still handed the late game to Lucian.
audit.why: Lucian's spikes are levels 1-3 poke and Relentless Pursuit; The Culling is 110s at rank 1, a long timer for a lane bully. Yorick's are Maiden at 6, Trinity Force, and the two-item side lane where a lone marksman cannot hold a tower against Maiden and the swarm.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[4].why, phases[5].why, phases[6].why, whys[5] and whys[6] to those spikes with cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Flagged defect — the page never names Lightslinger, Piercing Light or Ardent Blaze, and describes Relentless Pursuit only as 'his dash + reset' with no cooldown.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 at 445 range, and Riot's text says Lightslinger attacks reduce its cooldown — so tracking it by stopwatch is wrong, you count his double-shots. Piercing Light is 9s at rank 1 at 500 range and pierces through a target, which is why standing behind a minion does not save you. Ardent Blaze marks you and gives him move speed for attacking the mark, which is the tell that a kite is starting.
audit.corrected: All four named with cooldowns and ranges in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d and report[5].t.
